name: Shanghai Feilo Acoustics Co.,Ltd
summary: Shanghai Feilo Acoustics Co.,Ltd operates in lighting, automotive electronics, and module packaging and chip testing service businesses in China and internationally. The company offers automotive electronic products; module packaging and chip testing services for chip designers, chip manufacturers, and system integrators; precision manufacturing services; and inspection and testing services; and smart water management services, such as research and development on instrumentation and automation engineering and intelligent software and hardware products.
